temporary_flags.name: PHONE_AGENT_SPECULATIVE_PIPELINE
temporary_flags.purpose: Qualify speculative prefetch as a latency optimization inside the existing Cascade graph.

rollout_plan.success_criteria: Lower p95 turn latency without transcript, interruption, or semantic quality regression.
rollout_plan.abort_criteria: Any wrong-answer commit, stale audio, cancellation leak, or p95 regression.

rollback.procedure: Set the flag false and recycle only the warm Cascade worker; normal STT to LLM to TTS processing remains available.

temporary_flags.name: PHONE_AGENT_CONVERSATIONAL_REFLEX
temporary_flags.purpose: Evaluate short acknowledgement audio without allowing it to replace or contradict the model answer.

rollout_plan.success_criteria: Improved perceived responsiveness with no repetition, contradiction, or interruption regression.
rollout_plan.abort_criteria: Any scripted mirroring, semantic contradiction, double response, or barge-in regression.

rollback.procedure: Set the flag false; the substantive Cascade response path is unchanged.

temporary_flags.name: PHONE_AGENT_SUPERTONIC_FALLBACK_TO_EDGE
temporary_flags.purpose: Bound the migration fallback from local Supertonic synthesis to Edge TTS within Cascade.

rollout_plan.success_criteria: Every fallback is observable and preserves exactly one TTS output stream.
rollout_plan.abort_criteria: Unannounced provider switching, duplicate audio, or privacy/residency policy violation.

rollback.procedure: Set the flag false so Supertonic failure fails closed instead of switching provider.

temporary_flags.name: PHONE_AGENT_IDENTITY_PROPOSALS_ENABLED
temporary_flags.purpose: Canary model-proposed identity memory writes behind review and conflict controls.

rollout_plan.success_criteria: Accepted proposals are attributable, conflict-free, scoped, and reversible.
rollout_plan.abort_criteria: Cross-tenant leakage, unreviewed activation, identity conflict, or non-reversible write.

rollback.procedure: Set the flag false; existing reviewed identity data remains readable and no new proposal is written.

transition_controls.name: PHONE_AGENT_PIPELINE_MODE
transition_controls.purpose: Time-bound compatibility control while persisted S2S installations migrate to Cascade.

rollback.procedure: Set the control to cascade and restore the last qualified Cascade image; never re-enable S2S as a rollback strategy.

durable_controls.name: PHONE_AGENT_RECORDING_CONSENT
